picks.name: DeVotchKa
picks.description: The Denver chamber-pop ensemble brings their singular Balkan-gypsy-mariachi sound to Revolution Hall. String orchestrations, cinematic drama, and a lead singer who sings like the world is ending in the best possible way. One of the most distinctive live acts around.

picks.name: Pickathon 2026
picks.description: The beloved indie festival kicks off at Pendarvis Farm in Happy Valley — intimate stages, thoughtful curation, and a crowd that loves music. If you haven't been to Pickathon, it's worth it.

picks.name: Fremont Fest Marketplace
picks.description: The Beaumont-Wilshire neighborhood closes NE Fremont from 42nd to 51st for a full day of local vendors, food trucks, live music. A great excuse to explore one of NE Portland's best streets.

picks.name: Sellwood Street Fair
picks.description: One of Portland's most charming neighborhood fairs in one of its most charming neighborhoods — local vendors, live music, food, and that unhurried Sellwood energy. Free for all ages and a perfect summer Saturday.

picks.name: Oregon Chinese Festival
picks.description: Annual celebration of Chinese culture and community at Pioneer Courthouse Square, organized by the Oregon Chinese Coalition. Traditional performances, authentic food, cultural demonstrations, and a gathering that's been connecting Portland's Chinese community with the city for years.

picks.name: Timbers vs. Sounders
picks.description: The Cascadia Cup rivalry under the lights — Portland Timbers vs. Seattle Sounders at Providence Park. If you can't make the game, get to a bar and watch with your fellow Portlanders.

picks.name: Men in Black (1997)
picks.description: Portland Parks' Summer Free for All screens the 1997 sci-fi classic at Colonel Summers Park. Grab a blanket, pick up food from a nearby spot on SE Belmont, and watch Will Smith and Tommy Lee Jones save the planet from extraterrestrials as the sun goes down.

picks.name: Sunday Parkways
picks.description: Streets close to cars, bikes and pedestrians take over — Sunday Parkways returns to North Portland. Ride the route, hit free activities along the way, and enjoy the city at human speed. Family-friendly and quintessentially Portland.
